description: Information stored in systems and devices is not deleted when no longer required.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not systematically delete or dispose of information that is no longer needed for business or legal purposes, including data on active systems, backups, archived storage, and decommissioned devices.

metadata.detection_notes: Review data retention policies, deletion procedures, secure disposal processes, backup retention schedules, decommissioning procedures for hardware, and compliance with data retention regulations (GDPR right to erasure, etc.).
